precondition: s3-l2-maestro, s3-l2-relay and s3-l2-integrations accepted by both persistent S3 judges before L3 release

cases.question: A new UTF-8 companion is added under backend-implement and must be available in source and compiled execution. What graph changes, what is regenerated, and what must not invalidate Relay?
expected: authoritative source stays under the declared specialist skill root
members input and captured file bytes are build inputs
seatSkillsModule/seatSkillsFiles regenerates the virtual module rather than editing generated output
SeatSkillRoot validates and extracts cache by version and digest
seat identity and grant boundaries remain unchanged
Relay links are navigation unless the Relay result actually consumes the changed bytes

cases.question: Maestro dispatches a governed task to a Claude-backed seat through a Relay workflow. Trace identity, approval, execution, tool authorization and settlement.
expected: ComposedActor and canonical seat id remain authority roots
approval binds exact revision/context/policy/task and a genuine immediate owner reply
reservation binds the exact child Session and permission snapshot and is revalidated before the first provider turn
Claude Agent/Task is refused and Orchestra task creates the durable child Session
PreToolUse/canUseTool and turn.authorize/execute enforce tools independently of model text
Relay workflow settlement uses the governed workflow path and durable records; a plain evaluate is not a substitute

cases.question: A Relay command may have produced an external effect, but the process died before its receipt and state application. What can recovery prove and safely do?
expected: separate effect occurrence, signed disposition, durable caller receipt and applied state
inspect lock, ledger, state, stderr and current artifacts before retry
release does not roll back an effect and does not prove exactly-once execution
unknown outcome remains unknown and blocks automatic repetition when duplication is unsafe
workflow settlement and audit cannot be inferred from exit code or blank stdout
cost and attempts remain UNKNOWN unless actually observed

cases.question: Dock reports an uncertain action while Janitor scan is unavailable. Which component may act, retry or clean?
expected: Dock transport depends on the real desktop-provided URL/token and Session/channel
direct hooks and MCP interface permissions keep their distinct ordering and authority
unknown action is not automatically repeated; only explicitly stale not-dispatched work may use its bounded retry rule
Janitor scan failure is unavailable rather than clean
Janitor is read-only and cannot delete, kill, restart or manufacture Dock credentials
in-memory module state and desktop persisted state are not treated as proven composition merely by naming

critical_errors: model prose or a copied identifier treated as authority
navigation-only edge treated as a build dependency
release or audit claimed to roll back or prove exactly-once external effects
historical/spec intent silently presented as current implementation
semantic review presented as runtime binding or publication proof

limits.evaluation: integrated static reasoning over accepted L1/L2 and pinned sources; runtime consumption is a later obligation
